sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:192314
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 41134 of 2024

Applicant :- Abdul Bilal And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Chandra Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Aman Kumar Rai,Ashok Kumar Rai,G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today on behalf of the informant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Prem Chandra Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Aman Kumar Rai,
learned counsel for the informant and Sri Ajeet Madhesia, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicants on bail in Case Crime No. 141 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Hariparwat, District Agra during pendency of the trial.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that applicants are Devar of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, they have been made accused in the present matter.
5. He next submits that actually deceased was suffering with Tuberculosis and due to her illness she was in deep depression and only due to this reason deceased committed suicide by hanging herself.

sentences.text:
He further submits, however, post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to Asphyxia as a result of ante mortem injury and deceased also sustained five injuries and her hyoid bone was also found fractured but injury no.1 was circular mark around her neck which indicates that she hanged herself and other injuries are minor Blue contusions which could be sustained by the deceased when she made the attempt of suicide.
7.
He further submits, however, doctor did not disclose that it is a case of hanging but considering the fact that there was circular mark on her neck, it appears to be a case of suicidal death.

8. He further submits, however, hyoid bone of the deceased was found fractured but even in some exceptional cases of hanging hyoid bone of the deceased can be found fractured, therefore, merely due to the reason that hyoid bone was found fractured it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death.

9. He further submits, applicants are Devars and there is no specific allegation against them and only being younger brothers of the husband of the deceased, they have been made accused in the present matter.

10. He next submits that applicants being Devar was not having any concern with the family affairs of the deceased and in the present matter applicant nos. 1 and 3 are in jail since 24.04.2024 while applicant no.2 is in jail since 20.06.2024.

11. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted, however, applicants are Devars of the deceased but they resided in the same house where deceased resided and deceased died due to ante mortem injury and her hyoid bone was also found fractured
, therefore, at this stage, it cannot be said that it is a case of suicidal death.

They further submitted that from the post mortem, it reflects that deceased sustained one circular mark on her neck but they could not dispute the fact that in some cases of hanging also sometimes hyoid bone may be found fractured.
12. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. However, it reflects that Bhabhi of the applicants died within three and half years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and it also reflects that deceased sustained six injuries and doctor noted that deceased died due to Asphyxia as a result of ante mortem injury and her hyoid bone was also found fractured but considering the fact that in some cases of hanging also hyoid bone of the deceased may be found fractured, possibility of suicide at this stage cannot be ruled out even after considering the injury sustained by the deceased.

14. Further, applicants are Devar of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against them and argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicants that only being younger brothers of the husband of the deceased they have been made accused, cannot be ruled out at this stage.

sentences.text: Further, applicants are not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant nos. 1 and 3 are in jail since 24.04.2024 while applicant no.2 is in jail since 20.06.2024.

16. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicants are entitled to be released on bail.
17. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicants - Abdul Bilal, Rayyan @ Riyan and Momin be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless their personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicants.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 9.12.2024 AK Pandey  Abdul Bilal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167630401/
